pack_tensor_indexes: pack a PyTorch tensor of integer indexes into a compact bit-packed representation using int16 storage
unpack_packed_tensor: unpack a bit-packed PyTorch tensor back into the original integer index values with optional length
reshape_as_rectangle: reshape a PyTorch tensor into a rectangular shape with padding to fit a specified side length
review_pack_function: review the pack function that bit-packs integer index tensors for efficient storage in quantized models
review_unpack_function: review the unpack function that reverses bit-packing to restore original integer index tensors
